pages.text: [#](53341a)Not one neat pillar but a greater sundering — a large working that parts the land and sends the broken line wandering outward. Where Broken Earth is a trench, this is a sustained rift.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Moving Earth

pages.text:
[#](53341a)Worked from a large circle with **Dirt**, **Gravel**, or **Sand**. It becomes a staged rite that walks a tearing path away over time, and nearby Coven Witches widen it.[#]()

[#](53341a)Use it to divide a field, break pursuit, or command the earth aside.[#]()
pages.title: The Working
